### Patterns for Our Giving
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-march-22-2023.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 16:1-2
Points:
- Financial stewardship is a practical, spiritual duty flowing from the reality of the resurrection.
- Giving should be systematic and deliberate rather than dependent on spontaneous feelings.
- Offerings are to be proportionate to how God has individually prospered each believer.
- Christians have a primary responsibility to financially support their own church and family of faith.

### The Collection for Jerusalem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-collection-for-jerusalem
Passage: 1 Corinthians 16:1-3
Points:
- Specific apostolic instructions for first-century churches provide enduring principles for believers today.
- The collection for impoverished believers in Judea demonstrated the tangible unity of Jewish and Gentile Christians.
- Setting funds aside on the first day of the week highlights early Christian worship on the Lord's Day.
- Generosity should be proportionate to the measure of blessing and prosperity received from God.
- Churches must continually foster ministries of mercy that care for believers in need.
